steps.title: Shampoo
steps.description: Wash depending on how oily your scalp gets.
steps.alt: Straight hair — Shampoo: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Conditioner
steps.description:
Apply lightweight conditioner mainly to the mid-lengths and ends.

Use a hair mask occasionally if your ends feel dry.
steps.alt: Straight hair — Conditioner: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Remove Excess Water
steps.description: Gently squeeze excess water out with a microfiber towel or cotton T-shirt.
steps.alt: Straight hair — Remove Excess Water: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Detangle
steps.description: Detangle with a wide-tooth comb or gentle brush.
steps.alt: Straight hair — Detangle: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Leave-In / Heat Protectant
steps.description: Apply a lightweight leave-in conditioner or heat protectant if needed.
steps.alt: Straight hair — Leave-In / Heat Protectant: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Dry
steps.description: Air-dry or blow-dry on low heat.
steps.alt: Straight hair — Dry: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: If your ends are dry, apply a small amount of lightweight hair oil to the ends.
steps.alt: Straight hair — Finish: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Shampoo
steps.description:
Wash.

Use a gentle shampoo to cleanse without leaving your hair feeling stripped.

Use clarifying shampoo occasionally when product buildup occurs.
steps.alt: Wavy hair — Shampoo: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Conditioner
steps.description:
Apply a lightweight conditioner to the mid-lengths and ends.

Detangle gently while the conditioner is in your hair.

Use a more moisturizing conditioner if your hair is thick, coarse, or prone to dryness.
steps.alt: Wavy hair — Conditioner: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Leave-In Conditioner
steps.description: Apply a lightweight leave-in conditioner if needed.
steps.alt: Wavy hair — Leave-In Conditioner: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Mousse / Lightweight Gel
steps.description:
Scrunch in mousse or lightweight gel to enhance wave definition and reduce frizz.

Apply products in sections to distribute them evenly.
steps.alt: Wavy hair — Mousse / Lightweight Gel: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Remove Excess Water
steps.description: Gently scrunch out excess water with a microfiber towel or cotton T-shirt.
steps.alt: Wavy hair — Remove Excess Water: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Microplop
steps.description: Microplop your hair with a microfiber towel or 100% cotton T-shirt. Wrap the towel or T-shirt around your head. Leave it on to air dry for 15–30 minutes.
steps.alt: Wavy hair — Microplop: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Drying
steps.description: Gently diffuse your hair up on low heat or on cold air with a diffuser.
steps.alt: Wavy hair — Drying: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Scrunch Out the Cast
steps.description: Once completely dry, gently scrunch out any stiffness from the gel.
steps.alt: Wavy hair — Scrunch Out the Cast: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Finished Look
steps.description: Finished Look!
steps.alt: Wavy hair — Finished Look: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Shampoo
steps.description:
Wash with shampoo.

Use a gentle, moisturizing shampoo.
steps.alt: Curly hair — Shampoo: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Conditioner
steps.description:
Apply a moisturizing conditioner after shampooing.

Detangle gently with your fingers or a wide-tooth comb while the conditioner is in your hair.
steps.alt: Curly hair — Conditioner: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Leave-In Conditioner
steps.description: Apply a leave-in conditioner to damp hair.
steps.alt: Curly hair — Leave-In Conditioner: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Curl Cream + Gel
steps.description: Apply curl cream for moisture and definition, followed by curl-defining gel for hold.
steps.alt: Curly hair — Curl Cream + Gel: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Section Hair
steps.description: Divide hair into sections to distribute products evenly.
steps.alt: Curly hair — Section Hair: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Define Curls
steps.description: Use a styling brush or your fingers to define curls section by section.
steps.alt: Curly hair — Define Curls: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Scrunch
steps.description: Scrunch upward to encourage curl formation.
steps.alt: Curly hair — Scrunch: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Dry
steps.description: Air-dry or diffuse on low heat.
steps.alt: Curly hair — Dry: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Finish
steps.description:
Once completely dry, gently scrunch out any stiffness.

Add a small amount of hair oil to the ends if needed.
steps.alt: Curly hair — Finish: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Shampoo
steps.description:
Wash.

Use a gentle, moisturizing shampoo to cleanse the scalp while maintaining moisture.

Clarify occasionally when buildup occurs, especially if you use heavy creams, oils, or butters.
steps.alt: Coily hair — Shampoo: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Conditioner
steps.description:
Apply a rich, moisturizing conditioner after shampooing.

Detangle gently in small sections, working from the ends toward the roots.

Rinse thoroughly and avoid forcing a comb through knots.
steps.alt: Coily hair — Conditioner: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Leave-In Conditioner
steps.description: Apply a moisturizing leave-in conditioner to damp hair.
steps.alt: Coily hair — Leave-In Conditioner: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Cream / Butter + Gel / Custard
steps.description: Apply a styling cream or butter for moisture, followed by a defining gel or custard if desired.
steps.alt: Coily hair — Cream / Butter + Gel / Custard: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Section Hair
steps.description: Divide hair into approximately 4–8 sections, depending on density and length.
steps.alt: Coily hair — Section Hair: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Define Each Section
steps.description: Work through each section individually, using your fingers or a suitable styling brush to distribute products and define coils.
steps.alt: Coily hair — Define Each Section: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Stretch the Hair
steps.description: For a stretched style, try twists, braids, or banding.
steps.alt: Coily hair — Stretch the Hair: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Dry
steps.description: Air-dry or use a diffuser on low heat.
steps.alt: Coily hair — Dry: supplied hand-drawn illustration

steps.title: Finish
steps.description:
Once dry, gently separate or fluff the hair as desired.

Apply a small amount of oil to the ends if needed.
steps.alt: Coily hair — Finish: supplied hand-drawn illustration
